Maltese-flagged tanker Med Emre capsizes off Ibiza, killing a crew member

A tanker has capsized near Ibiza, killing a crew member. Aerial footage shows the capsized Maltese-flagged Med Emre chemical tanker off the Spanish island.

Reported by Al Jazeera; BBC; DW. Written by AI.
